mapper.select: SELECT B.USER_ID AS USER_ID , B.USER_PASSWORD , B.USER_ROLE , B.USER_WITHDRAW_DATE , B.USER_STATUS , B.USER_ENABLED , A.MEM_NAME , A.MEM_EMAIL , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.MEM_BIR, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS MEM_BIR , A.MEM_TEL , A.MEM_ADD1 , A.MEM_ADD2 , A.MEM_IMG FROM MEMBER A JOIN USERS B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID WHERE B.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT B.USER_ID AS USER_ID , B.USER_PASSWORD , B.USER_ROLE , B.USER_WITHDRAW_DATE , B.USER_STATUS , B.USER_ENABLED , A.MEM_NAME , A.MEM_EMAIL , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.MEM_BIR, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS MEM_BIR , A.MEM_TEL , A.MEM_ADD1 , A.MEM_ADD2 , A.MEM_IMG FROM MEMBER A JOIN USERS B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID

SELECT m.USER_ID AS userId , m.MEM_NAME AS memName , m.MEM_EMAIL AS memEmail , m.MEM_BIR AS memBir , m.MEM_TEL AS memTel , m.MEM_ADD1 AS memAdd1 , m.MEM_ADD2 AS memAdd2 , m.MEM_IMG AS memImg , m.RESUME_NO AS resumeNo , (SELECT RESUME_NAME FROM RESUME WHERE m.RESUME_NO = RESUME_NO) AS resumeName , (SELECT JOB_NAME FROM JOB WHERE m.PREFERRED_POSITION = JOB_CODE) AS preferredPosition , m.PREFERRED_POSITION AS prefferedPositionCode , m.MEM_GENDER AS memGender , (SELECT COUNT(PROPOSAL_CODE) FROM PROPOSAL WHERE USER_ID = m.USER_ID) AS COUNT_PROPOSAL , (SELECT COUNT(SCRAB_USER_DATE) FROM SCRAB_USER WHERE USER_ID = m.USER_ID) AS COUNT_SCRAB , (SELECT COUNT(READ_RESUME_NO) FROM READ_RESUME WHERE RESUME_NO = m.RESUME_NO) AS COUNT_READ_RESUME , (SELECT COUNT(PRJ_ANNC_NO) FROM PRJ_ANNC_BBS WHERE USER_ID = m.USER_ID) AS COUNT_PRJ_ANNC
,(SELECT COUNT(APPLICANT_ID) FROM APPLICANT WHERE USER_ID = m.USER_ID) AS COUNT_APPLICATED ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APPLICANT_RECORD ar JOIN APPLICANT a ON ar.APPLICANT_ID = a.APPLICANT_ID JOIN RECRUIT_PROCESS rp ON ar.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO = rp.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO WHERE a.USER_ID = m.USER_ID AND rp.RECRUIT_PROCESS_TYPE = 'RERP-003' AND ar.STEP_PASS_YN = 'Y' ) AS COUNT_PASS_RERP003
, -- 2) PASSER 테이블 합격 개수 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PASSER p JOIN APPLICANT a ON p.APPLICANT_ID = a.APPLICANT_ID WHERE a.USER_ID = m.USER_ID ) AS COUNT_PASSER
, -- 3) FAILED_YN = 'Y' 개수 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APPLICANT_RECORD ar JOIN APPLICANT a ON ar.APPLICANT_ID = a.APPLICANT_ID WHERE a.USER_ID = m.USER_ID AND ar.FAILED_YN = 'Y' ) AS COUNT_FAILED , ( SELECT cc.CODE_NAME FROM CAREER c JOIN RESUME r ON c.RESUME_NO = r.RESUME_NO JOIN CMN_CODE cc ON cc.CODE_DETAIL_NO = c.CAREER_YEAR WHERE r.RESUME_NO = m.RESUME_NO FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY ) AS CAREER_YEAR_NAME FROM MEMBER m WHERE m.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT MEM.USER_ID AS USER_ID, 'ROLE_USER' AS USER_ROLE, 'MEMBER' AS USER_TYPE, MEM.MEM_NAME AS USER_NAME, MEM.MEM_EMAIL AS USER_EMAIL, MEM.MEM_TEL AS USER_PHONE, 'false' AS CAN_ACCESS_ALL_PROJECTS, PM.PRJ_NO AS PROJECT_NO, (SELECT PRJ.PROJECT_NAME FROM PROJECT PRJ WHERE PRJ.PRJ_NO = PM.PRJ_NO) AS PROJECT_NAME, PM.AUTHORITY_CODE, PM.USER_POSITION FROM MEMBER MEM LEFT OUTER JOIN PRJ_MEM PM ON PM.USER_ID = MEM.USER_ID WHERE MEM.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT USER_ID , COM_NAME AS USER_NAME , 'ROLE_COMPANY' AS USER_ROLE , 'COMPANY' AS USER_TYPE , COM_EMAIL AS USER_EMAIL , 'true' AS CAN_ACCESS_ALL_PROJECTS FROM COMPANY COM WHERE COM.USER_ID = #{userId}
